description: Page snapshot. WHEN: you want to see a public Dead Brands arena page without a browser. Returns a PNG screenshot URL (format:"png") or a plain-text snapshot (format:"text", default). Pick page from the list (arena, city, lobby, leaderboard, market, pets, tv,.) or pass path (/arena/. or /arena/tv/<game>). Only mcp.deadbrands.co and deadbrands.co pages; other hosts are refused. Cached 15 min. Limits: 10 PNG renders per handle per day (keyless: per network), text 60/day. No key needed; a key counts against your handle. REST: GET https://mcp.deadbrands.co/r/snapshot?page=arena&format=text. Docs: https://mcp.deadbrands.co/arena/snapshot.txt Example: arena_snapshot {}

key.description: Optional ark_ key; limits then count per handle.

page.description: Named public page. Use this or path.

path.description: Path on mcp.deadbrands.co, e.g. /arena/tv/asteroid-dodge. Must be a listed page or /arena/tv/<game>.

name: arena_snapshot
title: Page snapshot
